main_text.p: [illegible, ~3 letters]Ex tribus contignationibus, id est, extertia contignatione, Act.20.9.

דּוּשׁChald. & Syr. Triturare, calcare, conculcare. Pahel דּוּשֵׁשׁ Calcare, conculcare, confringere, comminuere. Syr. [illegible, ~3 letters]. Unde Fut. יְדוּשֻׁן Ut conculcarent unus alium, Lucæ 12.1. Ithpeh, Ch. אִתְדְּשׁ, Syr. [illegible, ~3 letters] Conculcari, triturari.
דְּהָאדְּחָה Ch. Depellere, expellere, impellere, propellere, repellere. Sic Syr. Act.13.46.& 27.39. Ithpah, Inf. מִן לְאִדְּחָיָא Ab impellendo, hoc est, ab impulsione, seu lapsu. Psal.116.8.
דַּחְיָן Ch. Cantiones, aut Instrumeta musica, quòd tristitiam depellant, vel quòd exhilerent, quasi Hilaria dicas, per metathesin litterarū, à חֲדָה, Dan.6.18.

דַּחַףCh. Idem quod חָדָה Lætari, gaudere, מִדְחְרָא יִדְחֲרוּן לֵיהּ Exhilarando exhilarabitis eum, vel lætando læte, hilariter dabitis ei. videtur ד superfluum esse, pro מְחֶרָא תְּהָרִין, Deut.15.14.in Jon.
דְּחָךְCh. Irridere, subsannare. Idem quod דְּחָךְ per commutationem gutturalium, & נְחָךְ.
דְּחָלCh. & Syr. Metuere, timere, expavescere, vereri: Venerari, Colere, metony mice. Pahel דַּחֵל

page.notes: Large Hebrew and Syriac headwords in the left margin are transcribed as notes; several Syriac and Hebrew strings are uncertain and some are marked illegible. The Syriac headword at the start of the Syr. Conclavia entry and the Hebrew forms in the Pahel and Fut. entries could not be read with certainty.
